description: Conformance vectors for https://a2a-rust.com/extensions/failure/v1. Each 'valid' value reads as the class in 'reads'. Nothing is refused: each 'tolerated' value, which a sender must not write, is read as 'reads' (null: no class, which is not an error; the task's state still says it failed). Run by crates/a2a-protocol-types/tests/extension_vectors.rs, each value read through the SDK's own reader, and checked against the schema beside it.
carrier: Message.metadata of the failed task's status message

tolerated.name: an unrecognised token reads as internal
not a string reads as no class
